title: I'm Not The Only One
lyrics:
[00:24.84]You and me, we made a vow
[00:30.28]For better or for worse
[00:36.29]I can't believe you let me down
[00:40.22]But the proof's in the way it hurts
[00:47.83]For months on end, I've had my doubts
[00:53.76]Denying every tear
[00:59.58]I wish this would be over now
[01:03.61]But I know that I still need you here
[01:09.30]You say I'm crazy
[01:15.73]'Cause you don't think I know what you've done
[01:21.20]But when you call me baby
[01:27.45]I know I'm not the only one
[01:34.82]You've been so unavailable
[01:40.49]Now, sadly, I know why
[01:46.39]Your heart is unobtainable
[01:50.43]Even though, Lord knows you kept mine
[01:56.21]You say I'm crazy
[02:02.57]'Cause you don't think I know what you've done
[02:07.98]But when you call me baby
[02:14.26]I know I'm not the only one
[02:21.12]I have loved you for many years
[02:26.35]Maybe I am just not enough
[02:32.48]You've made me realise my deepest fear
[02:37.63]By lying and tearing us up
[02:42.98]You say I'm crazy
[02:49.38]'Cause you don't think I know what you've done
[02:54.82]But when you call me baby
[03:01.09]I know I'm not the only one
[03:06.48]You say I'm crazy
[03:12.78]'Cause you don't think I know what you've done
[03:18.22]But when you call me baby
[03:24.49]I know I'm not the only one
[03:30.35]I know I'm not the only one
[03:36.11]I know I'm not the only one
[03:41.98]And I know, and I know, and I know
[03:44.33]And I know, and I know, and I know, know
[03:47.90]I know I'm not the only one
